invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$66000（基于ATR 269.37和约1.6%风险），或融资费率转为正值（>0.01%）显示轧空机会消失，或日线跌破$65000关键支撑。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $66000 (based on ATR 269.37 and ~1.6% risk), or funding rate turns positive (>0.01%) indicating short squeeze opportunity fading, or daily break below $65000 key support.
